title: Feature Request: Support for Dexcom Share Servers as Data source
body:
Dear all, is it possible to add the support for dexcom share servers (US and outside US) as data source in XDRIP? I already use the nightscout app with this feature, but XDrip+ is more powerful!
The prediction feature is very nice, so I want to have it. I already user XDrip+ as a follower.

comments.body:
Would nightwatch meet your needs? I'm unsure if it has the prediction features or not...

This already indirectly works...
1) Use Nightscout to collect the data from the Dexcom Share servers: http://www.nightscout.info/wiki/welcome/nightscout-with-ios-and-dexcom-share
2) Setup xDrip+ as a Nightscout follower: https://jamorham.gitbooks.io/xdrip-plus/content/xdrip-plus-nightscout-viewer.html

It is implemented as `Dex SHare Follower`, isn't it?

I believe this issue can be closed.
